summary: Fixes the Adaptive operation so rest-machining finishing passes are generated only along edges not already inside the pre-cleared area, adds opt-in DEBUG_SVG diagnostics in libarea, exposes an internal clipperScale field, and bumps ADAPTIVE_GENERATOR_VERSION.

pages.reason: libarea/Adaptive.cpp: finishing passes now skip pre-cleared regions, which is a bug fix restoring the documented rest-machining behaviour; Path/Op/Adaptive.py only bumps ADAPTIVE_GENERATOR_VERSION; no property, default, enumeration or task-panel control changes

Source map mis-hit: libarea/Adaptive.cpp, Adaptive.hpp and pyarea.cpp implement the Adaptive clearing engine, not the CAM Area command this page describes; the new DebugSVGInfo struct is behind #ifdef DEBUG_SVG and clipperScale is an internal test-support field
